features.name: Anticipatory Stance
features.description:
When you choose this path at 3rd level, you can't be surprised unless incapacitated, and attacks against you before your first turn have disadvantage. If you take damage before your first turn, you can enter a rage as a reaction, gaining resistance to B/P/S from the triggering attack.

At 8th level: 1 extra reaction per turn (only for Path of the Inner Eye features). At 18th level: 2 extra reactions.

features.name: Insightful Dodge
features.description:
Beginning at 6th level, when you are hit by an attack while raging, you can use your reaction to move 5 feet. If this movement takes you beyond the attack's range, the attack misses instead.

Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.

payload.name: Insightful Dodge
payload.description: When hit by an attack while raging, move 5 ft. If this takes you out of range, the attack misses.

features.name: Foretelling Tactics
features.description: Starting at 10th level, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack while raging, up to two creatures of your choice who can see and hear you can each use a reaction to immediately move up to half their speed toward the target (no opportunity attacks) and make a single melee or ranged weapon attack against it. 1/short or long rest.

features.name: Preemptive Parry
features.description: At 14th level, if you are raging and a creature you can see within your reach hits another creature with a weapon attack, you can use your reaction to force the attacker to reroll and use the lower result. If still a hit, reduce damage by your weapon damage die + STR modifier.

payload.name: Preemptive Parry
payload.description: While raging: when a visible creature within reach hits another creature, force a reroll using the lower result. If still a hit, reduce damage by weapon die + STR mod.
